Caregivers provide essential support to patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI). However, limited research has been conducted to validate instruments that assess their self-perceived competence in caregiving. This study aimed to assess the psychometric properties of the 7-item Sense of Competence Questionnaire (S-SCQ) in informal caregivers of patients with MCI.
Background Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) represents a prodromal dementia stage marked by cognitive decline without functional impairment. Given limited drug efficacy and global aging, non-pharmacological interventions are urgently needed.
